method: Sketchfab public search API (downloadable=true, ~130 EN/RU queries, sort by relevance and -likeCount, paginated) + /v3/models/<uid> details + thumbnail review; OpenGameArt, poly.pizza, GitHub repo search checked for no-login sources.
licenseNotes: CC-BY: credit author+link. CC-BY-NC*: personal non-commercial only (marked in notes). Sketchfab-Free-Standard: not CC. Provenance: candidates whose description states game-mod/rip origin are rejected; "provenance not stated" = verify before shipping.

noLoginSources.opengameart: Checked (art-search-advanced, 3D). Only realistic-ish relevant item: UAZ-452 by Mehozavr (CC0) - downloaded. Others (Quaternius public transport, PSX style cars, Car Kit) stylized.
noLoginSources.polypizza: Checked (search pages, __SERVER_APP_STATE__). All vehicles stylized (Quaternius/Kay Lousberg CC0, Poly by Google CC-BY-3.0). GLB URL pattern: https://static.poly.pizza/<uuid>.glb where <uuid> = previewUrl basename. Nothing downloaded.
noLoginSources.kenney_quaternius: Kenney Car Kit / Quaternius cars: CC0 but stylized toy look - not downloaded.
noLoginSources.github: Repository search for lada/vaz/zhiguli/gazel models: no CC0/CC-BY glTF car repos found (only BeamNG mods / unrelated).
